additional_info.subject: RE: ID0478505-DC/Si-D/IT- [MP / R9 170002732] Log Check CRM:00263000458
additional_info.body:
Dear Maria,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0478505.
Ticket has been opened to analyze a session failed at authentication on charger MP/R9 170002732 on 15.02.2026.
I analyzed the logs, and here are my findings:
This is the outlet configuration of the charger:
Customer at 2026-02-15T08:50:09 authorized via app for outlet 2, but connected DC2 (which is outlet 3)
Session failed
At 2026-02-15T08:54:11 he authorized via app for outlet 1, but again connected DC2.
At 2026-02-15T09:00:25 a reboot was sent to the charger, but there was no problem with the charger.
In conclusion, sessions failed because the user authenticated and connected different outlets.
Since there is no issue on the charger and logs analysis has been provided, I will proceed to close this ticket.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
SI E EU CS TS
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
